basic_details.offering_entity: University of British Columbia (Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies - G+PS)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of British Columbia (Vancouver & Okanagan Campuses, BC, Canada)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all disciplines across Faculties of Science (Computer Science, Data Science, Physics, Chemistry, Zoology), Applied Science (Engineering, Architecture), Medicine, Forestry, Land & Food Systems, Arts, and Sauder School of Business.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~300 new Four Year Doctoral Fellowships awarded annually across UBC departments
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global competition; allocated based strictly on academic and research merit (typically 3 to 7 Pakistani doctoral scholars awarded/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 years (48 months) of guaranteed doctoral funding

nationality_requirements: Open to international and Canadian doctoral students holding full-time PhD candidature
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed Master's degree (18 years education) or exceptional first-class Bachelor's degree (minimum first-class average of 80% / A- or 3.70+ / 4.00 CGPA).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: UBC first-class average (80%+ or A- equivalent in Canadian grading).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Relevant foundational coursework and research methodology aligned with target doctoral program.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Entering first or second year of full-time doctoral studies at UBC.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Research publications, thesis output, and technical project leadership heavily evaluated.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS Academic minimum 7.0 (with no subscore below 6.5) or TOEFL iBT min 90 (with min 22 in all subscores).

eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Equal opportunity; diversity encouraged across research disciplines.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Top-tier doctoral candidates admitted to UBC.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not have already completed a doctoral degree.

tuition_fee.details: Full international tuition fee waiver provided for all 4 years of doctoral studies.

admission_application_fee.details: UBC graduate application fee (CAD $168.25 for international applicants) paid by applicant.

accommodation.details: Paid out of living stipend; on-campus graduate residences (Marine Drive, Acadia Park) or off-campus housing in Vancouver.

monthly_stipend.details: Guaranteed minimum annual stipend of at least CAD $18,200/year from 4YF, topped up by departmental Graduate Research Assistantship (GRA) or Teaching Assistantship (GTA) to reach CAD $27,000 to $34,000/year (~CAD $2,250 to $2,833/month / ~PKR 460,000 to 580,000/month).

airfare.details: Travel costs borne by student; select departments provide one-time arrival grants.

visa_fee.details: Canadian Study Permit fee (CAD $150) and biometric fee (CAD $85) paid by applicant.

health_insurance.details: British Columbia Medical Services Plan (MSP) provides provincial public health coverage for international students; supplementary AMS/GSS health & dental plan covered.
health_insurance.amount: 100% covered under BC MSP and AMS plan

books_and_materials_allowance.details: UBC research laboratories, departmental computing clusters, and library system access provided.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: G+PS Graduate Student Travel Fund (CAD $500/yr) plus departmental conference grants for presenting papers.

travel_transit_allowance.details: U-Pass BC transit pass providing unlimited bus, SkyTrain, and SeaBus access across Metro Vancouver included in student fees.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: University of British Columbia (Vancouver & Okanagan, BC, Canada).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: #38 QS World University Rankings 2025; Top 3 in Canada; #1 globally for climate action.
available_majors: Computer Science, Electrical & Computer Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Data Science, Mechanical Engineering, Physics & Astronomy, Chemistry, Forestry & Environmental Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Medical Genetics, Economics, Psychology
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: First-class academic record in previous degree, strong research potential, and alignment with UBC research supervisor.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Departments nominate their top admitted doctoral candidates; contacting prospective UBC supervisors in summer/fall is essential.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Supervisors with active NSERC or CIHR Discovery Grants often provide top-up funds above the base 4YF rate.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the UBC Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies online application system.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Connect with potential research supervisors in your field (September-November).
2. Submit formal online application to UBC doctoral program before departmental deadline (typically December 15 - January 15).
3. Upload transcripts, research proposal, CV, and contact details of 3 referees.
4. Departmental graduate admissions committee evaluates applications and nominates top candidates for 4YF.
5. G+PS confirms and issues official 4YF award letter with admission offer.
6. Accept offer, secure student number, and apply for Canadian Study Permit.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated nomination: candidates are automatically evaluated and nominated by their graduate program.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by 3 academic referees via UBC electronic referee portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of intent detailing research background, scholarly motivations, and doctoral dissertation goals at UBC.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research proposal (1-2 pages) describing research questions, methodology, and relevance.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing publications, presentations, awards, and technical competencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Prospective supervisors conduct technical video interviews via Zoom.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE is optional for most departments.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Original transcripts verified by home university registrar; attested copies submitted upon arrival.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned copy of valid international passport
Complete transcripts for 16-year and 18-year education with grading scale
Confidential reports from former professors and research mentors
Detailed essay outlining research interests and prospective dissertation focus

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual intake; deadlines vary slightly by department between Dec 15 and Jan 15.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 40% (Scholarly publications, conference papers, and thesis quality)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Departmental Graduate Admissions Committee and UBC Faculty of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Faculty supervisor endorsement -> Departmental ranking of admitted applicants -> Formal 4YF allocation by G+PS.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~5,500 doctoral applicants across all UBC faculties
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~300 Four Year Doctoral Fellowships per year
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with outstanding Master's GPA, peer-reviewed publications, and confirmed endorsement from a prominent UBC faculty member.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Pakistani researchers from NUST, LUMS, Quaid-i-Azam, UET Lahore, and FAST in computing, biomedical engineering, and forestry.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Canada, China, India, United States, Iran, Pakistan, Germany, Brazil.

red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee (CAD $168.25) is paid solely through UBC official portal. 4YF evaluation has no additional fee.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: UBC does not collaborate with education consultants for graduate admissions or fellowships.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: Canadian Study Permit application and biometric fee (CAD $235 / ~PKR 48,000)
Initial rental deposit in Vancouver (~CAD $1,200 to $1,800)
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: You need to submit a separate scholarship application. (Truth: All applicants to UBC doctoral programs are automatically considered for 4YF funding).
MYTH: Tuition is deducted from the stipend. (Truth: 4YF provides a 100% full tuition waiver on top of the living stipend).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Commercial sites quote base 4YF rates without mentioning mandatory departmental top-ups that raise total funding to CAD $27,000–$34,000/year.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Maintain minimum 80% (first-class average) in doctoral coursework and advance to PhD candidacy within 36 months.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research residence at UBC.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual supervisory committee progress review submitted to G+PS.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Teaching Assistantships limited to 12 hours per week to prevent thesis delays.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; international graduates qualify for BC PNP International Post-Graduate Stream (direct permanent residency nomination without a job offer).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding cancelled if candidate withdraws, switches to part-time status, or fails candidacy examination.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from graduate program advisor and G+PS.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: 4YF is valid for 48 months; funding for year 5 is typically provided via supervisor research grants.
